# Rajasekar Selvam

> Rajasekar Selvam is an independent software developer in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He designs and builds cross-platform apps with Flutter, end to end. He is the founder of Nikatru, a Government of India registered MSME (Udyam UDYAM-TN-02-0487004) established in 2021.
